title: Distilling neural networks into equations to predict planetary instability
abstract: arXiv:2610.35617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The problem of predicting when a multi-planet system will become dynamically unstable has defied analytical progress over the past three hundred years. Recent machine learning advances achieve high predictive performance of instability dynamics, but as black-box systems cannot be interpreted to connect to existing scientific understanding. Here we show analytic equations that predict when a multi-planet system will undergo instability. We discover these equations by first training a neural network on a dataset of N-body simulations, and then distilling its latent knowledge into closed-form algebraic expressions. Our two-stage pipeline first learns an interpretable variable basis, then searches for equations using symbolic regression. The resulting equations outperform existing analytic estimates of instability and apply across wide ranges of mass ratios, spacing, and orbital eccentricities. translated_title: 将神经网络蒸馏为方程以预测行星不稳定性
translated_abstract: 预测多行星系统何时会发生动力学不稳定的问题，在过去三百年间一直阻碍着解析方法取得进展。近年来机器学习的进展在预测不稳定性动力学方面实现了较高的性能，但作为黑箱系统，其结果无法被解释并与现有科学认知建立联系。本文展示了能够预测多行星系统何时发生不稳定性的解析方程。我们通过以下方式发现这些方程：首先在N体模拟数据集上训练神经网络，然后将其潜在知识蒸馏为闭合形式的代数表达式。我们的两阶段流程首先学习一个可解释的变量基，然后利用符号回归搜索方程。所得方程的性能优于现有的不稳定性解析估计，并且适用于广泛的质量比、间距和轨道偏心率范围。它们捕捉了预测景观中的结构……
tldr: 研究者通过在N体模拟数据上训练神经网络，并利用符号回归将其知识蒸馏为闭合形式的代数表达式，首次推导出能够预测多行星系统何时发生动力学不稳定性的解析方程，其性能优于现有的解析估计。
en_tdlr: Researchers derive analytic equations predicting when multi-planet systems become dynamically unstable by training a neural network on N-body simulations and distilling its latent knowledge into closed-form algebraic expressions via symbolic regression, outperforming existing analytic estimates.
